product.name: Evidence Studio
product.description: A cloud-based development environment for building, testing, and deploying data products using SQL, markdown, and AI tools with integrated version control and real-time validation.

product.name: Evidence Query Engine
product.description: A server-side query engine that executes SQL queries on large datasets with sub-second response times, supporting multiple data sources and enterprise security features.

product.name: Self-Serve Analytics Interfaces
product.description: User interfaces including AI chat, explore pivot tables, and SQL console that allow end users to interact with data through natural language, drill-downs, and ad-hoc queries.

product.name: Access Control and Security Features
product.description: Enterprise-grade security including row-level and page-level access control, single sign-on, directory sync, encryption, and audit logging to protect data and manage user permissions.

product.name: Open Source Framework
product.description: An open source foundation for building data products using SQL and markdown, enabling community contributions and extensibility through plugins and custom data source adapters.
